resolutions.rationale: The candidate opens with the completion of selected article ALC1737-art-000311 (`Dar coſas redondas, y mazizas`) and then absorbs guide material belonging to the following `Dar coſas eſtendidas como libro` article. It is therefore not an independent start, but its grouping crosses a real subsequent boundary.

R-004 carries the independent margin start `Dar`; the remainder of its guide is fragmented across R-003/R-005 by OCR grouping, while same-witness OCR preserves the full ordered guide and associates the historical form region with `Huecac amaca`. The boundary start itself is real, but no lexical article object is promoted from OCR alone.

R-005 begins with `libro.`, the completion of the preceding `Dar coſas eſtendidas como libro` guide, and then contains the damaged guide region for the next article. The primary ALC1737 OCR preserves a separate `Dar coſas hondas como olla` start in this sequence, so the candidate is a continuation whose grouping absorbs a false-negative article start.

R-006 contains only the Cahita-form region belonging to the preceding `Dar coſas hondas como olla` article and is followed by the fresh R-007 `Dardo` start. It is therefore continuation material, not a lexical start.
